data.long_meaning: Jaylene is derived from the Hebrew name ‘Jael’ which means ‘mountain goat’ or ‘little goat’. This name also has Greek and Latin roots, where ‘Jay’ means ‘victorious’ and ‘Leon’ means ‘lion’. The name Jaylene can be interpreted as ‘Little Goddess’ or ‘Victorious Lioness’. The name Jaylene carries the meaning “Little Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jaylene usually hope their child will grow to embody little goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
